name: mod-matrix-widest
eval: document.getElementById('tab-mod').click(); [[1, 95], [2, 103], [3, 116]].forEach(([m, d]) => { const s = document.getElementById('combo-mod' + m + '_source'); s.selectedIndex = 9; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const e = document.getElementById('combo-mod' + m + '_dest'); e.selectedIndex = d; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); });

name: lanes-loaded-badges
eval: document.getElementById('gear-btn').click(); document.querySelectorAll('.lane').forEach((l) => l.classList.remove('empty')); document.querySelectorAll('.badge').forEach((b) => { b.hidden = false; }); document.querySelectorAll('.lane-nm, .lane-name .nm').forEach((n) => { n.textContent = 'Lichen choir.wav'; });

name: entry-open-hdr-54px
eval: document.getElementById('tab-streams').click(); window.__veOrig = window.__veOrig || window.__setLanguage; const veOpen = () => { const l = document.querySelector('#cell-output_gain .knob-label'); if (l && !document.querySelector('#cell-output_gain .knob-value-input')) l.click(); if (!document.querySelector('#cell-output_gain .knob-value-input')) throw new Error('entry field not open: cell-output_gain'); }; window.__setLanguage = (l) => { const r = window.__veOrig(l); veOpen(); return r; }; veOpen();
